name: Hayward Rubik's Rumble 2016

venue.name: [Hayward City Hall](http://www.hayward-ca.gov/)
venue.details: The competition will be held in the glass rotunda on the first floor

information: Like last year's Rubik's Rumble, registration can be paid online via PayPal prior to the competition, or on-site in cash on the day of the competition. While online registration is open, the cost to compete is $2n+10, where n is the number of events you wish to compete in, until 100 competitors have registered. After the online registration period ends, you can still register on-site on the day of the competition. Then, the cost to compete is $20 for 3x3 only.
